a.prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

SURVEYOR: a battery-powered surveying robot shaped like a tripod surveying instrument.
A boxy cool grey #9BA3AE metal head with one big round glass lens on the front and two small round glowing dot eyes below it, a short antenna with a tiny orange #E07A3A light.
Three thin perfectly STRAIGHT steel #6E7884 tripod legs (NOT rubber hose, rigid straight lines), one small mechanical claw arm.
Emotionless and precise. Still outlined in dark plum #3D3346 like everything else.

Create a wide landscape production sprite sheet with EXACTLY FIVE separate full-body poses of the SAME surveying robot in ONE horizontal row, left to right in the order below. Each sprite centered in its own equal-width invisible cell. Large empty magenta gutters separating the poses; all items vertically centered on the same row. Target 3000x1000 or equivalent high resolution; every full robot at least 500 pixels tall. Same head dimensions, lens, antenna, three straight unjointed steel legs and single mechanical claw arm across poses. Walk poses face RIGHT with clearly opposite leg strides and level bodies. For this battery-powered character, the specific SURVEYOR design overrides the generic rubber-hose limbs, gloves, shoes, mouth and pie eyes: NO gloves, NO cartoon shoes, NO mouth, NO pie eyes. Exactly TWO small luminous circular eyes beneath the large round optical lens. Stun has a spiral inside the LENS, keeping both small dot eyes. Hammer pose includes a small wooden survey stake with plain orange tag and tiny antenna; no soil or ground line. Only small nearby grey crackles around stun head, close enough to remain one crop. Reference image 1 is the master outline and cel-shading style; reference image 2 is drawing technique only, never copy its character or lettering. Do not reproduce the reference palette swatches. Flat pure #FF00FF background everywhere between all objects, including between the legs. No labels, captions, shadows, floor or borders.

1. SURVEYOR standing perfectly still and rigid on its three straight legs, lens eye scanning forward, antenna up
2. SURVEYOR walking to the RIGHT in side view, one straight leg stepping forward like a compass, body perfectly level, no bounce
3. SURVEYOR walking to the RIGHT in side view, the other straight leg stepping forward, body perfectly level
4. SURVEYOR driving a wooden survey stake into the ground with a small hammer held in a mechanical claw arm, precise and emotionless
5. SURVEYOR stunned and tilted, legs splayed, lens eye showing a spiral, small grey zigzag static sparks around its head
